messages:
maria: Quick check — onboarding kestrel-7b-q (q4_0) into the catalog. Where are the final weights? Tokenizer is sometimes dropping leading space on assistant outputs (noticed in sampled evals). Config validator is also throwing a context_length mismatch. Planning perf runs this afternoon; need recommended batch sizes for latency vs throughput tradeoffs. CC @aj @kevin

aj: weights are in s3://redwood-models/kestrel/7b/q4_0/weights.pt (latest upload 2026-03-10, md5: ab12c3...). There's an extra artifact for tokenizer fixes at s3://redwood-artifacts/kestrel/tokenizer_patch.tar.gz
aj: note the quantized weights are sharded: weights.pt.00 .. weights.pt.03 — use `rwd-model-loader --sharded s3://...` to assemble.
aj: :thumbsup:

kevin: tokenizer issue likely from the HF "fast" tokenizer not being configured to add prefix space. Quick test patch:
```
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
hf_tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("./kestrel-tokenizer", add_prefix_space=True)
# or when wrapping tokenizers lib: tokenizer.add_prefix_space = True
```
kevin: also check `tokenizer_config.json` inside the tar.gz — I saw duplicate entries for `add_prefix_space` (one true, one false). That explains sporadic behavior.

sam: config validator output snippet:
```
ERROR model_config: context_length=2048 != model.max_length=4096
path: /etc/redwood/models/kestrel/config.json
```
sam: quick patch suggestion for the catalog entry runtime block:
```
"runtime": {
  "context_length": 4096,
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 8192,
    "preferred_batch_size": [1,2,4,8]
  }
}
```

bench-bot: perf-smoke run (a100-s1) 2026-03-11T15:02Z:
```
model: kestrel-7b-q (q4_0)
seq=512, batch=1 => p50=42ms p95=68ms throughput=23 tok/s
seq=512, batch=4 => p50=45ms p95=85ms throughput=86 tok/s
memory: 22GB GPU used, KV cache OK
```

lia: For the catalog metadata we should add tags: `quantization: q4_0`, `sharded: true`, `compatibility: hosted,dedicated`. Also please attach the eval prompt set (sanity/regen/long-context) so quality baselines are stored.

maria: Plan for today: infra to provision a100-s1 x2 at 15:00, full bench sweep at ~15:30 (seq lengths: 128/512/1024; batch sizes: 1/2/4/8). Need recommendation on preferred batch sizes to include in catalog runtime. @infra-bot can you confirm node availability?

infra-bot: nodes reserved: a100-s1 x2 on cluster `dedicated-east` until 2026-03-11T18:00Z. Image: rwd-runtime:v2.3.4. Reservation ID: res-5591. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll open a PR with the updated catalog entry + tokenizer patch pointer and request review. Will gate merge on bench p95 targets and tokenization sanity. :rocket:

kevin: CR note — if `vocab_fix` changes token ids we'll need to remap the embedding matrix or re-run the tie embeddings step. Double-check `vocab.json` diffs before applying.

aj: I'll assemble the shards and run a quick smoke bench now, will post logs in ~30m.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing the loop once PR merged and bench p95 for seq512 batch1 < 100ms.
